correctness.rationale: Cycle parity obstructs shattering. Every tree-component edge labeling admits precisely two vertex colorings and a fixed-cardinality solution exactly when the stated polynomial coefficient is positive; every possible component count is realized. Balanced components imply |S|<=2a and connected positive paths imply |S|<=n-2. The explicit 2a-edge star is fully shattered when n>=3a+1. Bounded checks independently compare direct cut patterns and profile arithmetic for 100490 cases.
